# Hotel Sherpa Soul

> Boutique budget hotel in Thamel, Kathmandu, Nepal. Dedicated to quiet rooms, comfortable sleep, shared guest kitchen, 24/7 hot showers, and authentic Himalayan hospitality.

## Core Information
- Name: Hotel Sherpa Soul
- Address: Thamel Bhagawati Marg 26, Kathmandu 44600, Bagmati, Nepal
- Phone: +977 9851068219
- WhatsApp: +977 9818259472
- Email: info@hotelsherpasoul.com
- Website: https://hotelsherpasoul.com
- Motto: "No Restaurant. No Noise. Sleep Well."

## Key Services & Amenities
- Clean quiet rooms with en-suite bathrooms and 24/7 hot showers
- Air conditioning (AC) in Deluxe & Family room categories
- Free high-speed fiber-optic Wi-Fi throughout the hotel
- Self-catering shared guest kitchen with induction cooktop & refrigerator
- Free secure luggage storage for Himalayan trekkers
- 24/7 front desk & reception assistance
- Airport pickup and drop-off transfers from Kathmandu Airport (KTM)
- Direct booking privilege: 10% instant discount when booking directly

## Room Categories & Rates
- Budget Family Room: 1 King Bed + 1 Single Bed, en-suite bathroom ($20 USD / ~NPR 2,700)
- Deluxe Room (AC): 1 King Bed, air conditioning, sofa seating, city views ($20 USD / ~NPR 2,700)
- Family Room (AC): 1 King Bed + 1 Single Bed, full air conditioning, private washroom ($30 USD / ~NPR 4,000)
